output.explanation: NIG-SA booked payable NIG-SA:ICV-SA-018986 at USD 15,960 against NIG-US receivable NIG-US:4471103 of USD 16,800 for INV-US-100439 (secondment, services), a ratio of 0.95. output.recommended_action: NIG-SA should reclassify the USD 840 withheld amount from the IC payable to a WHT payable/settlement clearing and provide the WHT certificate to NIG-US, so NIG-US can record a WHT receivable/tax credit against its IC receivable.
